en.title: Lacey Chabert Returns to Hallmark for Disney World Christmas Magic
en.summary: Hallmark's beloved Countdown to Christmas slate just got a major dose of Disney magic with the first trailer for Lacey Chabert's latest holiday film. The movie promises a wish come true at the Most Magical Place on Earth.
en.body:
Get ready for a dose of pure holiday enchantment, because **Lacey Chabert** is heading back to the **Hallmark Channel** for a brand-new Christmas movie that’s set to be a magical experience in more ways than one. The first trailer has officially dropped for "Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True," and it’s already got fans dreaming of festive cheer and theme park wonder.

This year’s **Countdown to Christmas** offering sees Chabert, a true MVP of Hallmark holiday films, stepping into the role of Lindsey. The premise centers on Lindsey and her extended family embarking on a journey to the iconic **Disney World**, where holiday wishes are seemingly made to come true. The trailer gives us a glimpse of the classic Hallmark charm we’ve come to expect, interwoven with the unmistakable sparkle of the Florida resort. It looks like the perfect blend of heartwarming family moments and the unique joy that only a trip to Disney can bring during the holiday season. The addition of **Richard Kind**, a beloved actor with a knack for bringing warmth and humor to his roles, further elevates the anticipation for this festive feature.

## A Wish Upon a Star (and a Camera)

The decision to set "Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True" within the enchanting grounds of **Disney World** is a stroke of marketing genius for both Hallmark and Disney. It leverages the powerful brand recognition and nostalgic appeal of both entities, creating a synergy that is sure to draw in a massive audience. For fans who have grown up with Hallmark's holiday movies and dreamed of a Disney Christmas, this film offers the ultimate convergence of festive fantasies. The trailer itself highlights the collaborative spirit, with Chabert expressing her excitement about being "joined by some special friends at The Most Magical Place On Earth."

## What Fans Are Saying

The immediate reaction from fans online has been overwhelmingly positive. The mention of **Disney World** has sparked conversations about potential cameos, iconic park locations featured, and the overall festive atmosphere. Many are eager to see how the narrative will weave together the traditional elements of a Hallmark Christmas story with the specific magic of the Disney parks. The combination of **Lacey Chabert** and a **Disney World** setting for a holiday film is precisely the kind of escapism many viewers are seeking, making this one of the most anticipated films of the upcoming **Countdown to Christmas** lineup.

## What's Next

"Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True" is slated to premiere on the **Hallmark Channel** later in 2026 as part of their extensive **Countdown to Christmas** programming. Further details regarding the full cast and specific plot points will likely be revealed as the premiere date approaches.

content_raw: Hallmark's new Christmas movie is basically a commercial for Disney World. But it also stars Richard Kind, so we're willing to give it the benefit of the doubt.
